name: TECHSTORE
recent: TECHSTORE 正在推进员工认股权计划（ESOS），最高可占已发行股份的 10%，并已于 2026 年 11 月 27 日向 Bursa Malaysia 提交上市申请。此外，董事经理 Tan Hock Lim 于 2026 年 9 月 3 日以每股 RM0.16 增持了 50,000 股普通股。近期没有重要新闻。
notable: 最高可占已发行股份的 10%。
公司已于 2026 年 11 月 27 日向 Bursa Malaysia 提交 ESOS 的上市申请。
董事经理 Tan Hock Lim 于 2026 年 9 月 3 日以每股 RM0.16 增持 50,000 股普通股。
risks: ESOS 最高可发行相当于已发行股份 10% 的新股，可能对现有股东权益产生摊薄效应。

recent_en: TECHSTORE is proceeding with an Employees' Share Option Scheme (ESOS) of up to 10% of its issued shares, and submitted the listing application to Bursa Malaysia on 27 November 2026. Separately, Managing Director Tan Hock Lim acquired 50,000 ordinary shares at RM0.16 per share on 3 September 2026. There is no significant recent news.
notable_en: The Company proposed an Employees' Share Option Scheme (ESOS) of up to 10% of its issued shares.
The Company submitted the listing application for the ESOS to Bursa Malaysia on 27 November 2026.
Managing Director Tan Hock Lim acquired 50,000 ordinary shares at RM0.16 per share on 3 September 2026.
risks_en: The ESOS may issue new shares of up to 10% of the issued share capital, which could dilute existing shareholders' equity.
